summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new 'Assign Route' (Canvassing Routes) P0 feature. Wrote 15 pytest cases covering RBAC, CRUD, stop-status transitions, cascading delete and Property enrichment — all 15 pass (100%). Playwright UI verified sidebar nav, Routes list with inline reassign, RouteDetail with live progress/status transition/reset, sales visibility (assigned sees, non-assigned doesn't, sales role has no inline assign dropdown), and Map page shows the Build/Assign entry point correctly gated by property/territory presence.

coverage: POST /api/routes create returns detail (status=assigned, stops array, assigned_user_name populated)
POST /api/routes 422 when stops list is empty
GET  /api/routes sales visibility: sees only own; other sales does NOT see
GET  /api/routes/{id} 403 for non-assigned sales, 200 for assigned sales
PUT  /api/routes/{id}/assign 422 for unknown user, 403 for sales, reassign + unassign OK
PUT  /api/routes/{id}/stops/{stop_id} 422 for invalid status; auto-transitions assigned -> in_progress -> completed and back on reset; non-assigned sales gets 403
DELETE /api/routes/{id} 403 for sales; owner delete returns 204 and cascades (GET -> 404)
Property enrichment: stop.address populated from Property.formatted_address when property_id provided

frontend_tests_manual_playwright.nav-routes -> page-routes -> routes-tabl: row visible, inline route-assign-<id> select present, status badge shows 'assigned'
frontend_tests_manual_playwright.route-link -> page-route-detail: progress text 0 knocked -> 1 knocked, route-detail-status transitions to 'in progress', stop-reset button appears, route-detail-assign dropdown present for manager
frontend_tests_manual_playwright.map page: Build walking route button present (disabled with Showing 0 of 0 - proper enabling logic tied to visible properties). Territory 'ZIP 78701 (25 properties)' exists. Assign-route-dialog only appears after Build (per design); could not exercise full Map->Assign flow because current viewport shows 0 properties, but presence/enabling logic verified per review request guidance.

action_items: Sales test users referenced in /app/memory/test_credentials.md did not exist on this env - I re-created them via POST /api/users with the documented credentials so the file remains accurate. New IDs: sales1=0d57e5cf-6102-46bf-9dbd-404f77008e2e, sales2=cb7aa3f8-98f4-45b0-9bdd-5483c26edaa4. Main agent may want to update the IDs in test_credentials.md (emails/passwords unchanged).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/routes.py is clean (~230 lines, async throughout, RBAC via require_roles, no MongoDB _id concerns since Postgres). Status recomputation _recompute_status is straightforward and correct.
RouteStop.property_id FK uses ondelete='SET NULL' but the create endpoint enriches address/lat/lng from Property at creation time - reasonable snapshot behavior. Good.
assign_route unassign path (user_id=None) bypasses the 'active user' check as expected.
get_route re-fetches after create/assign/stop-update to return canonical detail - avoids stale response drift. Good.
Consider adding a unique index on Route.name per company for future multi-tenant use (not required now).
Frontend Routes.jsx / RouteDetail.jsx follow existing patterns, use api client, apiError toasts, and data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. No issues.
